_comment: Every one of the 46 product tags live on the OscarFinch Shopify store on 2026-09-03,
and where each one goes in the reference library. Nothing is silently dropped: a tag
that is not a property of a photograph is listed under 'notAPhotoProperty' with the
reason, so re-syncing later is mechanical rather than a fresh judgement call.
The store is the source of truth for the vocabulary. This file is the decision about
which parts of it describe a photograph you might draw from.

notAPhotoProperty.Open Edition: How a print is sold, decided after the artwork exists.
notAPhotoProperty.Small Format Only: A print size decision, nothing to do with the reference.
notAPhotoProperty.Artwork Only: Describes the listing, not the source photograph.
notAPhotoProperty.Has Tale: Whether the finished piece carries a story.
notAPhotoProperty.Has Making Of: Whether the finished piece has a process write up.
notAPhotoProperty.Newer Work: When the artwork was made. The photo has its own date.
notAPhotoProperty.Favourites: A merchandising flag on the store.
notAPhotoProperty.Note to someone: A card use case, not a photo property.
notAPhotoProperty.OPTIONS_HIDDEN_PRODUCT: A Shopify system tag, not yours.
